notes.text: Submit three spiral-bound copies.
Use 1.5 line spacing throughout.
Paper: Letter.
Margins: top 1in, bottom 1in, left 1in, right 1in.
Body font: Times New Roman (100% of the document).
Body font size: 12 pt (100% of the document).
Body line spacing: double (75% of the document).
Body alignment: justified (100% of the document).
First-line indent: 0in (100% of the document).
Level 1 headings font: Times New Roman (100% of the document).
Level 1 headings size: 12 pt (100% of the document).
Level 1 headings bold: yes (100% of the document).
Level 1 headings: capital letters (100%).
Level 1 headings: centred (100%).
Level 2 headings font: Times New Roman (100% of the document).
Level 2 headings size: 12 pt (100% of the document).
Level 2 headings bold: yes (100% of the document).
Level 2 headings: capital letters (100%).
Level 2 headings: justified (100%).
Preliminary pages, in order: Declaration, Certification, Dedication, Acknowledgement, Table of Contents, List of Figures, List of Tables, Abstract.
5 chapters.
Chapter labels: CHAPTER ONE (100% of the document).
Preliminary pages numbered i, ii, iii.
Page numbers at the bottom center.
Table captions: above (100% of the document).
Figure captions: below (100% of the document).
Reference hanging indent: 0.5in (100% of the document).
Reference line spacing: 1.5 (100% of the document).
